Lycopenes and related compounds


In the US, tomato products provide more than 85% of the total quantity of lycopene consumed by the human population. Mean
lycopene intakes in the US are considerably greater than they are in the UK, where the mean daily intake is thought to be less than
one-third that in the US, while lycopene intakes in Far Eastern countries such as China and Thailand appear to be much lower still.
